title: Sustainable Farming Practices Explained Through Diversification
reason: Describes various sustainable agricultural practices and their benefits.

tasks.task: Explain the importance of environmental sustainability practices in agriculture.

subtasks.text: Note the benefits of planting cover crops, such as improved soil health and reduced erosion.
Describe how no till or reduced till methods can reduce soil loss and improve soil health.

tasks.task: Highlight the role of integrated pest management (IPM) in sustainable agriculture.

subtasks.text: Explain that IPM uses a range of methods to control pest populations without heavy chemical use.
Describe the benefits of integrating livestock and crops in sustainable farming.

tasks.task: Discuss the importance of diversification in sustainable agriculture.

subtasks.text: Mention crop rotations as a key diversification practice.
Explain the purpose of planting cover crops in crop rotations.
